Thus the original input-cell description can be recovered from the standard one by applying the inverse of this transformation, with no origin shift.

Together these two fixed orbits define the Rb and N sublattices of the conventional R-3c description.

This orbit has multiplicity 18, so the full oxygen array is generated from that representative by the operations of R-3c. The oxygen representative therefore lies on the plane z = 1/4, displaced along x from the nitrogen site at (0, 0, 1/4), while its y coordinate remains zero.

No precision corrections are supplied, so the listed representative coordinates are already the corrected input values at the stated six-decimal precision. The complete structure is therefore the R-3c arrangement generated from Rb at 6b (0, 0, 0), N at 6a (0, 0, 1/4), and O at 18e (0.793937, 0, 1/4), expressed relative to the stated rhombohedral input cell and the specified frame transformation.
